definitions.explanation: A pair of thin sticks used for eating, held in one hand. The polite form with the prefix お is the standard everyday term.

examples.japanese: お{箸|はし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
お{箸|はし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{持|も}ち{方|かた}→持ち方：28218_mochikata⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦きれい→きれい：00717_kirei⟧です⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧。

⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ころ→〜ころ：03091_koro⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、お{箸|はし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{正|ただ}しい→正しい：00893_tadashii⟧⟦{持|も}ち{方|かた}→持ち方：28218_mochikata⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{教|おそ}わる→教わる：02024_osowaru⟧。
examples.english: In Japan, children are taught the proper way to hold chopsticks.

notes:
The お prefix is the ordinary everyday form and does not sound formal; plain ⟦{箸|はし}→箸：01026_hashi⟧ is normal in writing and in compounds.

TYPES:
- ⟦{割|わ}り{箸|ばし}→割り箸：09725_waribashi⟧: disposable (split) chopsticks
- ⟦{塗|ぬ}り{箸|ばし}→塗り箸：31386_nuribashi⟧: lacquered chopsticks
- ⟦{菜箸|さいばし}→菜箸：04473_saibashi⟧: long cooking chopsticks
- マイ⟦{箸|はし}→箸：01026_hashi⟧: one's own chopsticks, carried to avoid disposable ones

CULTURAL NOTE:
Several uses of chopsticks are taboo: ⟦{刺|さ}し→刺す：02111_sasu⟧{箸|ばし} (stabbing food), {迷|まよ}い{箸|ばし} (hovering over the dishes), ⟦{渡|わた}し→渡す：02442_watasu⟧{箸|ばし} (resting chopsticks across a bowl), and passing food from chopsticks to chopsticks ({箸渡|はしわた}し), which recalls the passing of bones at a cremation.
